## 3. Overlaps and duplicate authority
- Capacity: placement R001.15 and R750 (AIMD, breakers, GPU budgets) vs decision-engine R112 and arbora (R001.15 itself says arbora owns AIMD). Owner: decision-engine for the decision, arbora for control.
- Placement solvers in one file: R001 (place), R004 (route_heavy_job), R700 (0-1 plan). Owner: R001 for tick-level feasibility, R004 for job claim routing, R700 consumes both.
- R611 cluster route model re-declares PlacementRoute, already in epistemic_operations/placement_operations.rs. Owner: engine-parity.
- R751 schedule/leadership/lease vs durable-kernel scheduler. Owner: durable-kernel for leases, R751 for cron specs.
- Sharing: identity R023.1 (private/placement/tenant), R023.13 (private/org/commons), R610 (tenancy chain), src/server/foreign_share.rs. Three enums for one idea. Owner: R610 for visibility, R023.13 for grants, one enum.
- R023.600 restates R610.2; R002.6-.12 and .15 are text edits of another spec (13 DUP rows).
- Ecosystem package risk (supply R009) vs finance/data-platform impact: no clash found.
